Lighter/LIT prints as a top Day crypto momentum setup; no verifiable listing/partnership news midday. Not a chase.
Joby Aviation top Day stock setup on momentum into US open; no company-specific headline midday. Prior close.

Canary staked Injective ETF (INJC) live on Nasdaq remains the standout catalyst (BitGo custody, ≥90% staked). Buzz still elevated vs early-week baseline though cooling vs the launch spike. Price roughly flat 24h — score slightly tempered vs morning as the billboard news ages, not as a chase.

Hyperliquid Strategies FCM/futures-broker path (CFTC filing disclosed with Q3) still the constructive regulatory catalyst, but $HYPE remains soft after the post-announcement fade and earlier Binance withdrawal friction chatter. Mixed — catalyst ≠ chase the token.

Amundi’s tokenized Core STOXX Europe 600 share class on Ethereum remains the lead TradFi RWA catalyst; Devcon 8 wrapped in Mumbai with builder energy. Price still soft (~−6% 24h) with majors. Hot NFP is a mild macro headwind for risk. mump2p validator latency tooling adoption is nice but not a price catalyst.
DASH screening on momentum; no new Dash-specific news. Not treated as bullish on scan alone.
Coinbase still coupled to BTC/ETF risk-off (Nov 5 outflows) and the soft crypto tape; regulated options/perps institutional path remains a background positive. Prior close into US open.
CAP still screening as momentum but no verifiable news catalyst — treat as price/volume only.

BTW is the open Day momentum hold after a trail sell (+£0.16) and re-buy; 24h ~+18%. No verifiable fundamental catalyst found — treat as price/volume action only. Explicitly NOT scored bullish on the run-up.

Still risk-off: Nov 5 spot BTC ETFs ~$430M net outflows (FBTC/IBIT led); BTC recovered ~$76k midday after the ~$75.2k low but 24h still ~−5%. Fresh: Oct payrolls crushed (165k vs ~59k exp, UE 4.1%) — hotter labor keeps rate-cut hopes in check. Mild constructive offset: Moscow Exchange plans BTC/ETH/USDT trading from Dec 1. Do not treat the bounce as new bullish news.
BlackSky still a top Day stock momentum setup; no fresh company headline midday. Prior US close.
BEAM Day-setup print only; no verifiable catalyst. Soft 24h with alts.
Akash (AKT) quiet midday — no new GPU marketplace/partnership headline.
Payward/Kraken AAVE partnership framing and Aave Horizon RWA still the background catalyst; no newer headline midday. Mild positive carry of that narrative.

US still pre-open (~14:30 UK). Nasdaq’s Nov 5 ~−5.5% AI-regulation hangover still the tape; hot Oct NFP (+165k) adds a mild higher-for-longer rates overhang into the open. No Apple-specific product/earnings catalyst midday.
Zscaler had no company-specific news; rides the Nov 5 growth/tech selloff as a high-beta software name. Prior US close only — expected pre-open, not stale feed.

Zcash showed relative strength through the Nov 5/6 dump (held near ~$1.25k while BTC ~−6%), helped by the fresh NU7 upgrade (25s blocks, fee redirection) and Tachyon scaling narrative. Constructive vs majors, not a blind chase of the earlier spike.

GateHub launched MiCA-regulated euro stablecoin EURGH on the XRP Ledger (1:1 bank-backed, free SEPA mint/redeem) — a concrete XRPL payments catalyst. Price still soft near $1.18 after the risk-off session; community breakout chatter from earlier looks overtaken by the dump.
Spotify quiet overnight with no product/earnings catalyst; soft with the growth-stock tape after Nov 5. Prior close only ahead of US cash open.
SOON on Day scans without a verified news catalyst this morning. Low-confidence, non-chase.

Fresh: Solana Labs launched Leap (Dialect) — mobile onchain trading of tokenized stocks/ETFs/crypto via Jupiter, fees later buy/burn SOL. Breakpoint London still Nov 15–17; prior Schroders EM-bond + Samsung Wallet USDC-on-Solana catalysts intact. Price ~$89 soft with the tape, buzz cooled hard after the night spike.

Riot’s ~$28B / up-to-$54B Corsicana AI data-center lease (910 MW) from Nov 4 remains the live catalyst; miner-to-AI pivot narrative intact even as AI-infra names sold off Nov 5. Prior close only ahead of US open.
Royal Gold quietly constructive as a gold royalty name into a risk-off equity tape; no company-specific headline. Prior close.
Roblox had no fresh product/earnings catalyst overnight; mild Day-setup presence only. Prior US close.
No PEPE-specific catalyst; general memecoin “attention = price” chatter from Pump.fun does not count as a dated PEPE event. Price mixed with alts.
NextEra quiet; Day-setup momentum only, no fresh utility/AI-power headline this morning. Prior close.
MicroStrategy tracks BTC; with spot near $75.2k and Nov 5 ETF outflows, bias soft into the US open. No fresh treasury-purchase headline overnight.

Microsoft sat in the Nov 5 AI/tech washout (Nasdaq −5.5%); Chanos flagged dumping of names like MSFT/Nvidia into pricey defensives. No fresh Azure/company catalyst overnight — prior-close print, US still shut.

Monad community still guessing on Cards Session 2 / airdrop appreciation with $MON ~$0.017 after the dump — speculation only, no dated listing or mainnet catalyst overnight. Buzz cooled vs the midday spike.
Intuitive Surgical quiet overnight with no earnings/product catalyst; light Day-setup print only. Prior US close.

Canary’s staked Injective ETF (INJC) is now live on Nasdaq — Times Square billboard, BitGo custody, stakes ≥90% of INJ, 1.10% fee. Concrete institutional catalyst even as INJ trades soft with the alt tape. Strongest single-name crypto catalyst in this run.

Mixed: Hyperliquid Strategies filed to offer regulated US futures (FCM path) and Elysium L2 (HYPE gas) still targets Nov 9 mainnet — but Binance HYPE withdrawals remain restricted post-hack (~$200M stuck) and price holds ~$77 after the slide from $97. Buzz partially rebounded from the night collapse but still well below midday.

Amundi (Europe’s largest AM) launched a tokenized Core STOXX Europe 600 share class on Ethereum — real TradFi RWA signal. Offset by ~$100M ETH ETF outflows Nov 5 and ETH sitting near the $2.21k 24h low with the broader dump. Validators adopting mump2p for faster blocks is a mild infra plus.

EDGE reversed hard overnight (~near 24h lows after the prior FOMO spike) with still no listing/partnership catalyst and the Nov 2 unlock overhang. Classic post-spike fade — score negative, not a bounce chase.

Coinbase’s regulated options/perps-for-institutions catalyst still on the board, but the name is tightly coupled to the crypto dump (BTC ~$75k) after Nov 5’s risk-off session. Prior close; score dialled back.

Upbit listed Collector Crypt CARDS (KRW/BTC/USDT) Nov 5 — real exchange catalyst — but the token has already cooled hard from the post-list spike (near mid/lower 24h range). Dialled back vs midday; not chasing the faded pop.
BTW on Day scans with an elevated 24h range; no verified fundamental catalyst this slot. Not treated as a chase.

Risk-off hangover: Nov 5 spot BTC ETFs saw ~$430M net outflows (Fidelity/BlackRock led) as BTC slid to a ~$75.2k low with heavy liquidations, tracking the Nasdaq dump. Mild offset from White House review of an SEC crypto broker-dealer rule proposal. US payrolls due later today (13:30 UK) are the next swing factor.
BlackSky prints as a top Day stock setup on momentum; no company-specific headline overnight. Prior US close only — expected pre-open.
APR still printing as a Day momentum setup; no separate news catalyst verified this morning. Low-confidence neutral/slightly constructive on structure only.
Akash (AKT) quiet overnight — no new GPU marketplace or partnership headline. Mild Day-setup presence only.
AKE shows a huge range expansion off the 24h low in Day scans, but no verifiable listing/partnership/unlock news overnight. Score stays flat — price-chase “top gainer” recaps are ignored.

Payward (Kraken parent) open-market AAVE buy / partnership framing still the lead catalyst; Aave Horizon keeps showing up in the RWA-collateral DeFi narrative (~$4.1B RWA in lending). AAVE held up better than many alts near $129.

US tech/AI sold off hard Nov 5 (Nasdaq ~−5.5%) on data-center cost and post-midterm policy worries; Apple had no company-specific catalyst and is still prior close pre-US open. Soft tape into Friday payrolls.

XRP failed at the $1.30-1.34 resistance traders were watching and is ~-6.5% to ~$1.22 with the market. Dated XRPL news: GateHub/Dinaro launched EURGH, a MiCA-compliant euro stablecoin on XRP Ledger, and the fixCleanup3_4_0 amendment activated Nov 4. X chatter is falling.

SOL ~-5.6% with the market, but fresh adoption news: Samsung Wallet launched USDC on Solana for eligible US Galaxy users (about 82M devices) on Nov 5, after Schroders' tokenized EM bond fund earlier today. Breakpoint London runs Nov 15-17.

HYPE dropped below $78 (from a $97 peak) and ~-6.7% today; Binance has reopened withdrawals in phases after its hack but still restricts HYPE, leaving ~$200M stuck. Elysium L2 (HYPE gas) mainnet still set for Nov 9. X mentions have cooled sharply.

ETH lost $2,300 and is ~-8% on the day in the broad crypto/tech selloff, underperforming BTC and giving back the ETH/BTC breakout. Offsetting real news: Amundi (EUR 2.4T AUM) launched a tokenized STOXX Europe 600 fund share class on Ethereum.

Sharp risk-off evening: BTC fell ~5-6% from above $80k to a $75.6k range low with ~$400M of longs liquidated in an hour, tracking a Nasdaq drop of over 3% on AI-spend worries after the midterms. Range $75k-$81k still intact. White House began reviewing an SEC proposal easing crypto broker-dealer rules (mild positive). US jobs report Fri 13:30 UK is the next swing factor.

Payward (Kraken's parent) bought AAVE on the open market via its affiliated fund, framed by Aave's CEO as a partnership to expand onchain lending. AAVE held roughly flat (~-0.4%) on a day the market fell 5-8%.
No fresh Zscaler news midday; holding prior-close quote ahead of US cash open. Neutral.

Zilliqa announced a pivot from standalone L1 to an Ethereum L2 'Institutional Layer' (permissioned marketplace, LEI identity; LTIN sequencer). Structural reset after low usage — mixed: constructive for survival/liquidity, but community unease and DEX wind-down.

Zcash NU7 (faster 25s blocks) is the Nov 5 activation event; price already ran hard into it (+high-single to low-double digits earlier) and is only +~1% now — classic sell-the-news risk dominates over the upgrade itself.
Tezos +~10% 24h in scanners without a fresh headline catalyst midday. Score near flat; do not credit the print as news.

Whale wallets ≥1M XRP at a 2026 high (2,147); Garlinghouse reaffirmed XRP centrality post-Swell; Ripple/C2FO/BNY trade-finance push on XRPL. Price ~$1.31 with heavy price-target chatter — treat hype as noise.
No fresh Worldcoin catalyst midday; price soft ~−3% over 24h while majors hold. Score stays neutral pending verifiable news.
SUPER appearing in Day momentum (+~8.5% 24h); no verified catalyst beyond tape. Neutral.
No Spotify-specific catalyst; shares still marked from the Nov 4 risk-on session. Neutral-to-slightly positive on residual market tone only.

Schroders ($1.1T AUM) launched a tokenized emerging-markets bond fund share class on Solana via Centrifuge — real TradFi RWA signal. Coinbase institutional options/perps also cover SOL. Mildly constructive beyond price noise.
RENDER slightly green; AI-narrative tape but no new Render Network announcement found this slot.
Premier African Minerals (PRE.L) green on LSE scanners; no verified catalyst found. Neutral.
PIEVERSE up ~11% 24h in Day scans; no separate news catalyst verified. Neutral/low-confidence.
PEARL in top gainers (+~8.5%); no verified news. Price-only — low confidence neutral.
Oxford Nanopore quiet midday with LSE open; ~flat 24h. No catalyst found.
NEAR soft on the day; Pump.fun multichain mention is not NEAR-specific news. Neutral.
MicroStrategy tracks BTC's hold near $80k and the post-midterm risk-on tape; +~5% 24h. No company-specific filing midday — beta to BTC/sentiment.

MSFT still digesting the Nov 4 ~7% surge to ~$555 / $4.1T; Thursday US futures mixed with Nasdaq soft on chip weakness (Qualcomm guide). Azure strength intact, but post-rally fade risk into the US open (14:30 UK).
Monad remains a focus coin; Pump.fun called out Monad among its multichain additions, but no fresh Monad-specific mainnet/listing catalyst midday. Price soft.
Intuitive Surgical screening strong (+~9% vs prior mark) but quote may be stale/prior session and no fresh company news verified midday. Low confidence.

Nasdaq approved listing for Canary's staked Injective ETF (INJC) — stakes ≥90% of INJ, BitGo custodian, 1.10% fee; still needs final S-1 before trading. Buzz elevated vs prior days; INJ +~7.5% 24h. Strongest structural crypto catalyst this slot.

Kinetiq Elysium L2 (HYPE gas) still targeting Nov 9 mainnet with day-one builder support; HYPE consolidating ~$82 after crowded longs / unlock chatter. Mildly constructive into the launch, not a chase.

FLUID has real recent catalysts (DEX v2 limited beta Oct 29; 50% JupLend revenue to DAO) but also India's ED naming Instadapp/Fluid in a FEMA probe (~$40M alleged). Token already +23% 24h — buzz is chasing the move; net only mildly positive.

ETH ETFs snapped outflows with $53M on Nov 4; ETH/BTC broke its multi-month downtrend; Vitalik at Devcon 8 pushing trustless hardware/AI. ETH ~$2,385 (+~3% 24h). Institutional options/perps access via Coinbase-Deribit is a mild structural positive.

EDGE already up ~39% in 24h on pure volume/FOMO — Korean coverage notes no listing/partnership catalyst today; Nov 2 unlock (~4.25% mcap) remains an overhang and price rejected near $0.114. Do not treat the runup as bullish news.
Coinbase opened CFTC-regulated options/perps access for eligible US institutions via Prime/Deribit — a concrete product catalyst beyond the election rally.

Upbit listed Collector Crypt CARDS (KRW/BTC/USDT) with trading from 16:30 KST Nov 5 — a real exchange catalyst. Token already +~16% 24h into/around the listing, so some of the move is priced; still the clearest mid-cap catalyst today.
CAP screening as a Day momentum setup (+~14% 24h) but no verifiable news catalyst found midday — treat as price/volume only, not sentiment-led.

Spot BTC ETFs still showing the Nov 4 $74.6M inflow flip; Bitcoin Amsterdam 2026 opens today with packed halls; price holding ~$79.5k after the midterm bounce. Tom Lee argues Democrat crypto softening could help, but five-day ETF totals remain deeply negative.
BP token in scanners (+~9%); no verified catalyst midday. Neutral/low conf.
Bitcoin Cash tracking the BTC hold near $80k region with no BCH-specific catalyst. Neutral.
Cosmos ATOM +~7% 24h without a standalone midday headline. Neutral.
Aerodrome mild green; no fresh catalyst midday. Low-confidence neutral.

Apple rode the Nov 4 broad rally; no company-specific catalyst midday. US futures mixed after the election surge — score dialled back vs morning as the move digests. Quote still prior close until US cash open.
Zcash NU7 network upgrade activates at block 3,543,405 around Nov 5, cutting block time 75s to 25s; price already ran ~7-13% into it, with heavy long/short positioning, so sell-the-news risk.

Wallets holding 1M+ XRP hit a 2026 high of 2,147 (Santiment, accumulation); Garlinghouse reaffirmed XRP central to Ripple at Swell; price ~$1.31 testing resistance. Much of the chatter is price-target hype.
Microsoft rose ~7% on Nov 4 to a record ~$555 ($4.1T cap) as markets rallied on the Democratic midterm sweep, building on Azure +48% last quarter. Partly a post-rally recap.
HYPE consolidating near $83-84 with crowded longs; Kinetiq's Elysium L2 (HYPE as gas) launches mainnet Nov 9; token unlocks noted as overhang.
Ethereum ETFs snapped a seven-day outflow streak with $53M net inflow on Nov 4 (ETHA led); ETH/BTC broke its multi-month downtrend line and ETH is up ~6% in 24h near $2,420.
Spot Bitcoin ETFs flipped to a $74.6M net inflow on Nov 4 after three days of outflows; BTC holding near $80.5k after the post-midterm rally. Moscow Exchange to list BTC spot trading from Dec 1.
Apple carried by the broad Nov 4 post-midterm rally (S&P +1.6% to a record); prior quarter revenue record $114.5B but management flagged rising memory costs from AI demand.

XRP pushed back above $1.30 with whale wallets (1M+ XRP) at a 2026 high of 2,147 and ~696M XRP withdrawn from exchanges; Ripple/C2FO trade-finance rollout on XRPL with BNY custody support; Coinbase US perps include XRP.
Injective launched Institutional Rail on Nov 2, an enterprise validator gateway run with Google Cloud, Deutsche Telekom, Kraken and BitGo, already in limited production.
ETH climbed from $2,220 to about $2,430, breaking a 4h descending channel, and ETH/BTC broke a long downtrend; spot ETFs still saw $85M outflows on Nov 3, so confirmation above $2,450 is pending.

BTC broke above $81k after Democrats won both chambers in the midterms, liquidating ~$320M of shorts; holding near $80k with analysts calling sellers exhausted, despite the Binance and Mercado Bitcoin breaches still in the background.
ZEC rebounded to ~$1,285 ahead of the NU7 upgrade on Nov 5 (25s blocks, fee reserve, Sprout retirement); privacy coins outperforming, but much of the move is pre-upgrade run-up and buzz is spiking.
ETH rebounded toward $2,320 with BTC; Devcon Mumbai demos of RollupX synchronous composability and Robinhood Chain (Arbitrum L2) hitting $100B Uniswap volume add constructive ecosystem news.

BTC made a V-shaped recovery above $78k after the midterm-night dip under $76k as US futures turned green on post-election gridlock; still weighed by the Binance hack fallout and a new ~$40M Mercado Bitcoin breach.

Privacy coins outperforming; NU7 upgrade due Nov 5. Offsets: dev-fund infighting, EU 2027 AML ban on privacy coins at licensed providers. Already up ~13% in 24h with rising buzz, so upgrade may be priced in.
Record 2,147 whale wallets (1M+ XRP) per Santiment, breakout above $1.27, new XRPL platform launch; much price-target hype discounted.
Pump.fun facing insider-promotion allegations over the $AMD meme coin; copycat $PUMP rebrand rug warnings add noise. Price up ~12% in 24h on momentum, not news.
Institutional Rail went live for select users, a real adoption step; price already up ~8% in 24h.
Bloomberg profile highlights $713M trailing revenue funding buybacks; Elysium L2 (HYPE gas) mainnet Nov 9 with OpenSea support.
ETH/BTC broke a multi-month downtrend (above ~0.0295); treasury holders exploring yield beyond staking. Constructive but driven by technicals.
BTC whipsawed on US midterm-election night, dipping under $76k on Nov 4 before reclaiming ~$78k; heavy ETF outflows and a reported Binance security issue weigh, stablecoin supply at a 1-year low.
Record quarter and services, but shares dipped on margin guidance; Nvidia retook the top market-cap spot.
Privacy coins outperforming BTC; ZEC ~$1,200-1,230, top-10 by market cap, flat on the day. NU7 network upgrade scheduled for Nov 5 (faster blocks). Large YTD run-up means crowded positioning.

Broke out of a tight Bollinger squeeze to $1.27-1.29; XRPL added 7,934 new wallets on Nov 1. Offset by community frustration after a news-light Swell and resurfaced 2017 sell emails. Breakout is technical, not news-driven.

Category Labs published the Monad Private Settlement Domains whitepaper (Nov 3) for institutional private settlement, with community interest; price still weak (-5% 24h), so sentiment improves from very negative but stays below neutral.

Bloomberg profile of Hyperliquid: $713M trailing revenue funding buybacks, ICE and Kraken exploring its tech; HYPE ~$85-87. Some trader complaints about losses farming on Hyperliquid. No new dated catalyst.
ETH/BTC broke a multi-month downtrend above ~0.0295 (ETH $2,250-2,290); rotation-to-alts talk. mump2p block propagation now carries 8% of staked ETH. Mostly chart-driven optimism.

Dipped to ~$76.2k then bounced back above $77k on US midterm day; ETF outflows over $1B across two days (IBIT -$405M Nov 2) continue, but volume is subdued and traders frame it as accumulation; $76.5-77k support, W pattern toward $81k cited.
LayerZero: minor protocol upgrade posts; STG-to-ZRO conversion window closes Dec 15; chartists flag bearish head and shoulders after bounce. Bounced ~4% in 24h on a burst entry.
Zcash near $1,205 ($20B cap), +200% YTD; NU7 network upgrade scheduled Nov 5 to cut block times. Bullish chatter but coin has already run hard this year.
Community let down after Ripple Swell: no big announcements; Garlinghouse denied abandoning XRP for RLUSD, cited $900M revenue run rate. Split reaction, price near $1.25-1.29.
TRON passed 16B cumulative transactions, leads USDT supply ($92B vs ETH $87B); Canary staked TRX ETF and regulated TRX futures on Bitnomial drawing TradFi.
SOL eased to ~$92-93 with the market; fee-capture debate; Samsung USDC sends on Galaxy devices noted as adoption.

MON ~ $0.0174, down ~9% in 24h and about half from ~$0.034. Talk centres on a large November anniversary token unlock (16B+ claimed) and airdrop resentment; small ecosystem raise (CRSHMARKET $3.5M seed). Some contrarian 'max buy' posts.
IRYS down ~95% from its high; small bounce (+7% 24h). Posts talk of market-maker games and shorts; no fundamental news.
Bloomberg profile of Hyperliquid co-founder Jeff Yan: $713M revenue last year funding HYPE buybacks; ICE deal for regulated 24/7 markets pending. HYPE ~$85, -3% 24h with the market.

Holo up ~44% in 24h, trending on CoinGecko, after HoloFuel went live Nov 1 (HOT-to-HoloFuel swap). Mostly hype posts; skeptics say HoloFuel has little utility and expect a dump once swaps settle. Move has already happened.
Followed BTC lower, under $2,250 at the low; mump2p faster block propagation adoption (3.36M ETH) is incremental tech news, not price-moving.

Slid below $77k as US midterm polls opened; record IBIT outflow ($405M on Nov 2, ~$399M net across spot ETFs); testing $74-76.8k support after 5 red weeks. Historical post-midterm dips cited; holds above 50-week MA.

XRP ~$1.25, flat. Holders frustrated after Ripple Swell (no price catalyst, RLUSD focus) though Garlinghouse reaffirmed XRP's role; 7,934 new wallets on Nov 1. XRPL fixCleanup3_4_0 amendment (token-mint loophole fix) has 33/35 validators, could activate Nov 4 - routine fix, not price-moving.

THORChain halted swaps on ~10 chains (ETH, BTC, SOL...) after an Oct 31 Ethereum one-block reorg caused a 10 ETH payout from an empty vault; user returned funds, fixes in progress, trading live only on AVAX, BASE, RUNE, XRPL as of Nov 2. variants.ev_note: EV exit is off. books.name: main
books.label: Main book
books.blurb: Frozen rules. This is the book the cycle commits.

books.name: ev_exit
books.label: EV exit
books.blurb: EV exit is off. Live expected value rises when the trade falls, so it was selling winners between about +1% and +5%. This book was reset; sells before the reset are not counted. It follows the main book until the upside is taken from the current price and the chance is recomputed.

books.name: review_leftovers
books.label: Review leftovers
books.blurb: Burst stop is 1.5x wider unless live EV is already below -0.4%. Core's 18:00 fallback tranche is half size when the coin is up more than 15% over 7 days or RSI is above 75. New Day, Risk and Core entries need the coin's own 3-day trend up. After 12:00 UK, Day and Core will not each buy the same coin.

books.name: all_combined
books.label: Both together
books.blurb: The review leftovers, on one book. The EV exit is off (live expected value was inverted) and this book was reset; sells before the reset are not counted. The burst runner is a separate book, not part of this one.

books.name: burst_runner
books.label: Burst runner
books.blurb: Same rules as the main book, except a Burst position that hits its target keeps running when the entry signal is still intact. The trail then gives back 20% of the peak gain. Each sell says sold at target or ran, with the extra gain and the giveback.

books.name: everything
books.label: Everything combined
books.blurb: The review leftovers and the burst runner, on one book. The EV exit is off (live expected value was inverted) and this book was reset; sells before the reset are not counted.

books.name: midnight_crypto
books.label: Midnight crypto
books.blurb: Same as the main book, except Day crypto entries run until 23:45 UK and those positions flatten at 00:00 UK. New crypto entries are allowed again from 00:00, and the daily loss budget still resets then. Stocks still flatten 15 minutes before their market closes. Copied from the same snapshot as the other books.

books.name: entry_watch
books.label: Entry watch
books.blurb: Same scoring as the main book. Setups the cycle would buy are also armed with a price trigger, a size, and the same stop and target. This is the only book the live watcher is allowed to buy when that trigger trades between cycles. The main book only logs those as WOULD BUY.

books.name: risk_giveback_15
books.label: Risk giveback 15
books.blurb: Risk only. The trail still arms at +15% net. Once armed, it sells when the net gain falls to 65% of the peak net gain, and the 7-day exit waits while that trail is armed. The -12% stop stays. Not combined with the other paper books.

books.name: day_trail_arm
books.label: Day trail arm
books.blurb: Day only. A trail arms only when 60% of the peak gain is at least the greater of 4x that trade's round-trip cost and 1x its 1-hour ATR. Once armed, a crossed trail sells. Stop, target, the burst 6-hour hold and the 22:00 flatten stay.

books.name: day_ev_blend
books.label: Day EV blend
books.blurb: Day only. Each sub-strategy's expected value is its measured expectancy blended with the model: (n x measured + 10 x model) / (n + 10). Momentum and burst are measured apart. The Risk win is not changed on this book.

books.name: no_risk_clock
books.label: No risk clock
books.blurb: Risk only. The 24-hour re-entry clock is deleted. The next setup buys when its own confidence and expected value clear. No new-high gate and no stop-out cooldown.

books.name: day_capital_caution
books.label: Day capital caution
books.blurb: Day only, per account. f is that account's Day loss today divided by 15% of that account's start-of-day Day equity, with no cap at 1. Momentum's threshold is its base (0.35, or 0.30 on MON, WLD and XRP) plus 0.30 x f. Burst uses the same f. Size is multiplied by (1 - min(f, 1)). The -15% halt on the whole Day pot stays.

books.name: partial_take
books.label: Partial take
books.blurb: Day and Risk. At the trail arm, sell half and leave the rest on this book's trail. Buy that half back on a later dip only when a fresh expected value clears the hurdle. The fresh value uses a recomputed chance and the percent still available from the current price, not the inverted live EV. Orders in this split may be £1. Every other book keeps the £5 minimum. The sell records the extra fee of splitting one exit into two.

books.name: sent_split
books.label: Sentiment split
books.blurb: Burst and Risk. A missing sentiment print scores 0.50, the same as a real neutral, instead of 0.25. A Risk dip needs the 48-hour uptrend; positive sentiment does not stand in for it. When price is up 15% or more over 24 hours (5% or more over 4 hours on a Day momentum entry) and sentiment is at least 0.30, or the buzz change is 3 or more, burst and Risk confidence lose 0.10 and that Day momentum entry ignores sentiment. A catalyst score, when the file has one, is used instead of the raw score. A quiet tape (buzz change under 1.2) with volume at least 2x and a confirmed breakout or bounce adds 0.05. Files without those fields score as before.

books.name: best_of
books.label: Best of
books.blurb: Sentiment split, the entry watcher and the burst runner, and nothing else. A missing sentiment print is neutral (0.50). A Risk dip needs the 48-hour uptrend. Hot run-up and quiet-tape adjustments are the sentiment-split numbers. Armed entries expire after 15 minutes. A burst that hits its target can keep running and then gives back 20% of the peak gain. The EV exit stays off.

books.name: btc_trend
books.label: BTC trend
books.blurb: Crypto is 100% BTC when the daily close is above its 50-day average, otherwise cash. Stocks is the same rule on VUSA, or EQQQ if VUSA has no history. Checked once a day. Held through nights and weekends.

books.name: btc_trend_vol
books.label: BTC trend, vol sized
books.blurb: The same trend book, sized at min(1, 40% / 30-day realised vol). A weight only moves when it has drifted more than 5 points.

books.name: majors_rotation
books.label: Majors rotation
books.blurb: Once a week, hold the best 28-day return among BTC, ETH and SOL that are above their own 50-day average. Cash when none are. The stock half stays in cash.

books.name: btc_core_satellite
books.label: BTC core + satellite
books.blurb: 85% BTC, put back when it drifts more than 5 points, plus 15% in one coin that has beaten BTC over 30 and 90 days and is above its 100-day average. The satellite is held at least 5 days.

books.name: rs_rotation_veto
books.label: RS rotation, veto
books.blurb: Once a week, the top 3 by 4-week return minus BTC, above their 50-day average, skipping a buzz change of 3 or more or a 24h jump of 15% or more. BTC when none qualify. Cash when BTC is below its 50-day average.

books.name: quiet_strength
books.label: Quiet strength
books.blurb: Within 10% of the 30-day high, buzz below the median, top quartile of volume over market cap. Sold on a 12% trail or into a hype spike. Held through nights and weekends.

books.name: best_of_plus
books.label: Best of plus trend
books.blurb: Sentiment split, the 15-minute entry watch and the burst runner may use 15% of the book. The other 85% is the BTC / VUSA trend. Nothing flattens at 22:00.

books.name: trend_carry_unlock
books.label: Trend, funding and unlocks
books.blurb: Once a week, the strongest of BTC, ETH and SOL above its 50-day average, sized like the vol-target book. Crypto is halved when BTC funding is in the top tenth of the past year or at 25% a year or more. An alt unlocking more than 1% of supply within 30 days is left out; if that feed is missing, only BTC and ETH are held. A resize under 10% of the position is skipped. Stocks follow the vol-sized VUSA trend. Held through nights and weekends. Unlock dates: Data: PatternPlus (https://pattern.plus).

books.name: insider_rs_stocks
books.label: Insider relative strength
books.blurb: Once a month, the strongest US and UK names by six-month return. An opportunistic insider buy (not someone who trades that same month in earlier years) tilts the weight. The crypto half stays in cash. Held through nights and weekends.

books.name: risk_ev_fix
books.label: Risk EV fix
books.blurb: Risk only. A Risk entry's expected value starts from a replay of the pot's own breakout and dip rules and its own exits (12% stop, trail from +15%, 7-day hold) on past prices: that setup's hit rate, average win and average loss. Live closes move it as they build. The 0.3% hurdle, the stop, the trail and the confidence threshold are unchanged. The main book still uses a 3.5% win and a 50% chance, which can never clear the hurdle.

books.name: signal_engine
books.label: Signal engine
books.blurb: Once a week, start from that volatility size. News, the routine sentiment file, funding, unlocks, insider buys, trend, momentum, volatility and a short forecast can tilt it. A signal counts only when an older window and a later window agree it ranked with the next week's return.

books.name: signal_purge
books.label: Signal engine, purged
books.blurb: The same tilt, except a training label that reaches into the later window is dropped, and the first five days of that later window are left out. The two windows no longer share a return.

books.name: signal_equal
books.label: Signal engine, equal weight
books.blurb: A signal that passes the same two-window test gets an equal vote. The size of the correlation is not used as the bet size. The tilt is the average of the votes.

books.name: signal_multitest
books.label: Signal engine, multiple tests
books.blurb: The same tilt, but the bar is the correlation you would expect from the best of the nine signals if they were all noise. A weaker correlation is left out, even if both windows agree.

books.name: signal_news
books.label: Signal engine, news decay
books.blurb: The same tilt, except a headline fades with a three-day half life. An old headline does not stay fully in force until the next one.

books.name: signal_funding_contrarian
books.label: Funding, cash when hot
books.blurb: Once a week, hold BTC unless yesterday's annualised perpetual funding is hot.

books.name: signal_funding_carry
books.label: Funding carry
books.blurb: Once a week, hold BTC only when yesterday's annualised perpetual funding is hot: 25% a year, or above the prior year's 90th percentile.

books.name: signal_basis
books.label: Basis, cash when rich
books.blurb: Once a week, hold BTC when the previous 7-day perp premium is not rich.

books.name: signal_dvol
books.label: DVOL fear
books.blurb: Once a week, hold BTC when the previous Deribit volatility index is not in the top of its own past year.

books.name: signal_vrp

strategies.label: BTC trend, vol sized

strategies.name: rs_rotation_veto
strategies.label: RS rotation, veto
strategies.blurb: Once a week, the top 3 by 4-week return minus BTC, above their 50-day average, skipping a buzz change of 3 or more or a 24h jump of 15% or more. BTC when none qualify. Cash when BTC is below its 50-day average.

strategies.name: risk_ev_fix
strategies.label: Risk EV fix
strategies.blurb: Risk only. A Risk entry's expected value starts from a replay of the pot's own breakout and dip rules and its own exits (12% stop, trail from +15%, 7-day hold) on past prices: that setup's hit rate, average win and average loss. Live closes move it as they build. The 0.3% hurdle, the stop, the trail and the confidence threshold are unchanged. The main book still uses a 3.5% win and a 50% chance, which can never clear the hurdle.

strategies.name: all_combined
strategies.label: Both together
strategies.blurb: The review leftovers, on one book. The EV exit is off (live expected value was inverted) and this book was reset; sells before the reset are not counted. The burst runner is a separate book, not part of this one.

strategies.name: everything
strategies.label: Everything combined
strategies.blurb: The review leftovers and the burst runner, on one book. The EV exit is off (live expected value was inverted) and this book was reset; sells before the reset are not counted.

strategies.name: review_leftovers
strategies.label: Review leftovers
strategies.blurb: Burst stop is 1.5x wider unless live EV is already below -0.4%. Core's 18:00 fallback tranche is half size when the coin is up more than 15% over 7 days or RSI is above 75. New Day, Risk and Core entries need the coin's own 3-day trend up. After 12:00 UK, Day and Core will not each buy the same coin.

strategies.name: main
strategies.label: Main book
strategies.blurb: Frozen rules. This is the book the cycle commits.

strategies.name: partial_take
strategies.label: Partial take
strategies.blurb: Day and Risk. At the trail arm, sell half and leave the rest on this book's trail. Buy that half back on a later dip only when a fresh expected value clears the hurdle. The fresh value uses a recomputed chance and the percent still available from the current price, not the inverted live EV. Orders in this split may be £1. Every other book keeps the £5 minimum. The sell records the extra fee of splitting one exit into two.

strategies.name: day_trail_arm
strategies.label: Day trail arm
strategies.blurb: Day only. A trail arms only when 60% of the peak gain is at least the greater of 4x that trade's round-trip cost and 1x its 1-hour ATR. Once armed, a crossed trail sells. Stop, target, the burst 6-hour hold and the 22:00 flatten stay.

strategies.name: day_ev_blend
strategies.label: Day EV blend
strategies.blurb: Day only. Each sub-strategy's expected value is its measured expectancy blended with the model: (n x measured + 10 x model) / (n + 10). Momentum and burst are measured apart. The Risk win is not changed on this book.

strategies.name: ev_exit
strategies.label: EV exit
strategies.blurb: EV exit is off. Live expected value rises when the trade falls, so it was selling winners between about +1% and +5%. This book was reset; sells before the reset are not counted. It follows the main book until the upside is taken from the current price and the chance is recomputed.

strategies.name: burst_runner
strategies.label: Burst runner
strategies.blurb: Same rules as the main book, except a Burst position that hits its target keeps running when the entry signal is still intact. The trail then gives back 20% of the peak gain. Each sell says sold at target or ran, with the extra gain and the giveback.

strategies.name: day_capital_caution
strategies.label: Day capital caution
strategies.blurb: Day only, per account. f is that account's Day loss today divided by 15% of that account's start-of-day Day equity, with no cap at 1. Momentum's threshold is its base (0.35, or 0.30 on MON, WLD and XRP) plus 0.30 x f. Burst uses the same f. Size is multiplied by (1 - min(f, 1)). The -15% halt on the whole Day pot stays.

strategies.name: midnight_crypto
strategies.label: Midnight crypto
strategies.blurb: Same as the main book, except Day crypto entries run until 23:45 UK and those positions flatten at 00:00 UK. New crypto entries are allowed again from 00:00, and the daily loss budget still resets then. Stocks still flatten 15 minutes before their market closes. Copied from the same snapshot as the other books.

strategies.name: no_risk_clock
strategies.label: No risk clock
strategies.blurb: Risk only. The 24-hour re-entry clock is deleted. The next setup buys when its own confidence and expected value clear. No new-high gate and no stop-out cooldown.

strategies.name: entry_watch
strategies.label: Entry watch
strategies.blurb: Same scoring as the main book. Setups the cycle would buy are also armed with a price trigger, a size, and the same stop and target. This is the only book the live watcher is allowed to buy when that trigger trades between cycles. The main book only logs those as WOULD BUY.

strategies.name: risk_giveback_15
strategies.label: Risk giveback 15
strategies.blurb: Risk only. The trail still arms at +15% net. Once armed, it sells when the net gain falls to 65% of the peak net gain, and the 7-day exit waits while that trail is armed. The -12% stop stays. Not combined with the other paper books.

strategies.name: sent_split
strategies.label: Sentiment split
strategies.blurb: Burst and Risk. A missing sentiment print scores 0.50, the same as a real neutral, instead of 0.25. A Risk dip needs the 48-hour uptrend; positive sentiment does not stand in for it. When price is up 15% or more over 24 hours (5% or more over 4 hours on a Day momentum entry) and sentiment is at least 0.30, or the buzz change is 3 or more, burst and Risk confidence lose 0.10 and that Day momentum entry ignores sentiment. A catalyst score, when the file has one, is used instead of the raw score. A quiet tape (buzz change under 1.2) with volume at least 2x and a confirmed breakout or bounce adds 0.05. Files without those fields score as before.

strategies.name: best_of
strategies.label: Best of
strategies.blurb: Sentiment split, the entry watcher and the burst runner, and nothing else. A missing sentiment print is neutral (0.50). A Risk dip needs the 48-hour uptrend. Hot run-up and quiet-tape adjustments are the sentiment-split numbers. Armed entries expire after 15 minutes. A burst that hits its target can keep running and then gives back 20% of the peak gain. The EV exit stays off.

rulebook.name: main
rulebook.label: Main rules
rulebook.holds: Two accounts that never mix: £100 in crypto and £100 in stocks at the Test 2 start. Each account is split Core £50, Day £30 and Risk £20. Core holds longer growth names. Day holds two intraday books, momentum and burst, sharing that pot. Risk holds smaller speculative names. A pot may lend cash to another pot in the same account. Cash never crosses between the crypto account and the stock account.
rulebook.entry: Core adds to a name in daily slices after the weekly pick. Day momentum may buy from 08:00 UK when the score and the expected value after costs both clear, and it does not buy at or after 21:00. Burst buys a breakout that has enough volume. Risk buys a breakout, or a dip that has already bounced while the trend is still up. A name that is still falling is skipped. Less cash raises the hurdle and cuts the size. It does not halt the book.
rulebook.exit: Core sells a position that is 20% under its cost. There is no Core target; the weekly pick trims a winner. Day momentum uses a stop of about 2% to 5% and a target of about 4% to 12%, then a trail. Burst is tighter and also exits after 6 hours. Every Day position is sold at 22:00 UK, and a stock is sold 15 minutes before its market closes. A 15% loss on the Day pot stops new Day buys for the rest of that day. Risk sells at a 12% stop, or 10% under the peak after a 15% gain, or after 7 days. A 30% drop in the Risk pot stops new Risk buys.
rulebook.rebalance: Core picks again on Monday at 09:00 UK. Day does not hold a basket overnight, so it does not rebalance one. Risk does not rebalance; each position is its own trade.
rulebook.data: Live prices from Kraken, Coinbase, KyberSwap and Yahoo, a pound-dollar rate, Monad gas, and the sentiment file scored from news and X. A price that is getting old lowers confidence. It does not by itself block a sell.
rulebook.tweak: The frozen Core, Day and Risk rules. Every other row in this group changes one of them.

rulebook.entry: Buy the whole sleeve when the latest daily close is above its 50-day average.
rulebook.exit: Sell the whole sleeve when the close falls back to that average or below it.
rulebook.rebalance: Checked once a day. A sleeve is either fully invested or in cash.
rulebook.data: Kraken daily closes for BTC. Yahoo daily closes for the stock. Held through the night and the weekend.

rulebook.entry: In only while the close is above the 50-day average. The size is the smaller of full size and 40% divided by the last 30 days of realised volatility.
rulebook.exit: Out completely when the close is no longer above the average.
rulebook.rebalance: Once a day. A size change smaller than 5 points is skipped, so a quiet day does not trade.
rulebook.data: The same daily closes as the plain trend book. Held through the night and the weekend.

rulebook.exit: Cash when none of the three are above that average, and when the weekly pick changes.

rulebook.exit: The satellite is sold when it no longer qualifies, but not during its first 5 days.
rulebook.rebalance: Once a week. BTC is put back to 85% only after it has drifted by more than 5 points.

rulebook.exit: The trend half exits with the 50-day rule. The small half uses the Day and Risk exits. Nothing is forced flat at 22:00.

rulebook.rebalance: Once a week. A resize smaller than 10% of the current position is skipped.

rulebook.name: signal_gold
rulebook.label: Gold risk-on
rulebook.holds: BTC, or cash. The stock half stays in cash.
rulebook.entry: Once a month, hold BTC when the lagged 126-day gold return is negative.
rulebook.exit: Cash when gold is not down over that window. No gold history means cash. This is a hypothesis.
rulebook.rebalance: Once a month. The position is all or nothing.
rulebook.data: Gold daily closes, lagged one day. Shared cache.

rulebook.name: signal_onchain
rulebook.label: Active addresses
rulebook.holds: BTC, or cash. The stock half stays in cash.
rulebook.entry: Once a week, hold BTC when the lagged 30-day change in unique Bitcoin addresses is positive.
rulebook.exit: Cash when that change is not positive. No history means cash. This is a hypothesis.
rulebook.rebalance: Once a week. The position is all or nothing.
rulebook.data: Unique Bitcoin addresses, lagged one day. Shared cache.

rulebook.name: signal_gdelt
rulebook.label: News tone
rulebook.holds: BTC, or cash. The stock half stays in cash.
rulebook.entry: Once a week, hold BTC when the previous 7-day average news tone for Bitcoin is positive.
rulebook.exit: Cash when that tone is not positive. No tone history means cash.
rulebook.rebalance: Once a week. The position is all or nothing.
rulebook.data: GDELT tone, lagged so the week used ends the day before the decision. Shared cache. Separate from the hourly headline file.

rulebook.name: signal_dominance
rulebook.label: BTC dominance
rulebook.holds: BTC, or cash. The stock half stays in cash.
rulebook.entry: Once a week, hold BTC when lagged 30-day BTC dominance rose.
rulebook.exit: Cash when dominance did not rise over those 30 days. No history means cash. This is a hypothesis.
rulebook.rebalance: Once a week. The position is all or nothing.
rulebook.data: BTC share of crypto market cap, lagged one day. Shared cache.

rulebook.name: ev_exit
rulebook.label: EV exit
rulebook.tweak: Would sell when live expected value turns negative. That rule is off: the live number rose as the trade fell. This book was reset and now follows the main rules.

rulebook.name: review_leftovers
rulebook.label: Review leftovers
rulebook.tweak: Wider burst stop, a smaller Core fallback when a coin is extended, a 3-day uptrend on a new entry, and no Day plus Core buy of the same coin after midday.

rulebook.name: all_combined
rulebook.label: Both together
rulebook.tweak: The review leftovers on one book. The burst runner is not part of this one.

rulebook.name: burst_runner
rulebook.label: Burst runner
rulebook.tweak: A burst that hits its target keeps running, then gives back 20% of the peak gain.

rulebook.name: everything
rulebook.label: Everything combined
rulebook.tweak: The review leftovers and the burst runner, together.

rulebook.name: midnight_crypto
rulebook.label: Midnight crypto
rulebook.tweak: Day crypto may enter until 23:45 UK and flattens at midnight. Stocks still flatten before the close.

rulebook.name: entry_watch
rulebook.label: Entry watch
rulebook.tweak: Buys between cycles when an armed price trigger trades. The main book only logs that as a would-buy.

rulebook.name: risk_giveback_15
rulebook.label: Risk giveback 15
rulebook.tweak: After a Risk trade is up 15%, sell when the gain falls to 65% of the peak gain.

rulebook.name: day_trail_arm
rulebook.label: Day trail arm
rulebook.tweak: A Day trail arms only when 60% of the peak gain clears the round-trip cost and the 1-hour range.

rulebook.name: day_ev_blend
rulebook.label: Day EV blend
rulebook.tweak: A Day entry's expected value blends the model with that sleeve's own measured results.

rulebook.name: no_risk_clock
rulebook.label: No risk clock
rulebook.tweak: Risk may re-enter the same name without waiting 24 hours.

rulebook.name: day_capital_caution
rulebook.label: Day capital caution
rulebook.tweak: A losing Day account raises the entry hurdle and cuts size. The 15% halt on the Day pot stays.

rulebook.name: partial_take
rulebook.label: Partial take
rulebook.tweak: At the trail arm, sell half. Buy that half back on a dip only when a fresh expected value clears.

rulebook.name: sent_split
rulebook.label: Sentiment split
rulebook.tweak: Missing sentiment counts as neutral. A hot run-up is penalised, and a quiet tape can earn a small bonus.

rulebook.name: best_of
rulebook.label: Best of
rulebook.tweak: Sentiment split, the 15-minute entry watch, and the burst runner, together. No other main-rule change.

rulebook.name: risk_ev_fix
rulebook.label: Risk EV fix
rulebook.tweak: A Risk entry's expected value starts from a replay of the pot's own setups and exits on past prices, not a 3.5% win and a coin flip.

rows.label: News
rows.blurb: Mean finance-lexicon score of headlines in the hourly news file.

rows.label: Routine file
rows.blurb: The sentiment file the cycle already ingests, from -1 to 1.

rows.label: Funding
rows.blurb: Low BTC perpetual funding is the bullish reading. High funding is negative.

rows.label: Unlocks
rows.blurb: No large unlock is the bullish reading. A token unlocking supply is negative.

rows.label: Insider buys
rows.blurb: An opportunistic open-market insider buy in the last six months.

rows.label: Trend
rows.blurb: 1 when the close is above its 50-day average, otherwise -1.

rows.label: Momentum
rows.blurb: The last 28-day return, shrunk so a 20% move is the full score.

rows.label: Volatility
rows.blurb: Calm volatility is bullish. A realised vol of 40% is neutral and 80% is -1.

rows.label: 5-day forecast
rows.blurb: Half of the last 5-day return, shrunk. Kept only when that has predicted the next week.
